headline: Good and bad news for Italy: Economic growth will be higher, but the deficit exceeds the EU limit
summary: The Italian government raised its growth forecasts for this year and next. It also projects a 2027 budget deficit above the EU limit, the first time since 2019, due to higher military and energy spending.
why: Italy is the euro area's third-largest economy, and its deficit path affects EU fiscal rules and Italian government bond yields. Investors watch its budget plans closely for sovereign debt risk.
